statements.t: We generally recognize revenue from our Managed Services contracts over time using an input method based on costs relative to total expected costs, as content and services are delivered.

• does not include stock-based compensation expense, which is a non-cash expense, but has been, and will continue to be for the foreseeable future, a significant recurring expense for our business and an essential part of our compensation strategy;

• does not include stock issued for payment of services, which is a non-cash expense, but has been, and is expected to be for the foreseeable future, an important means for us to compensate our directors, vendors, and other parties who provide us with services;

Because of these limitations, Adjusted EBITDA should not be considered a measure of discretionary cash available to us to invest in the operation and growth of our business or as a measure of cash that will be available to us to meet our obligations.
Our presentation of this non-GAAP financial measure should also not be construed to infer that our future results will be unaffected by unusual or non-recurring items.

We continue to manage operating expenses in line with our financial performance and expect to increase spending as revenue growth supports additional investment in our technology platform, business development activities, and working capital requirements.
Beginning in early 2025, we realigned our commercial model to focus on larger, recurring enterprise customers while reducing our emphasis on lower-value, project-based engagements.

Supported by improved bookings activity and anticipated campaign execution, we expect revenue to return to year-over-year growth in the fourth quarter of 2026, with sequential growth over the third quarter as well.

estimates.t: There have been no material changes to our critical accounting policies as set forth in Item 7, “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” included in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025.
